Canonical scene brief: A lean bearded poet in white sitting under a banyan tree in a wild forest, a palm leaf on his knee, writing with his own finger in a shallow bowl of dark red; a stack of finished leaves beside him; small blue-lit spirits listening between the trunks; a tall dignified blue spirit, Kāṇabhūti, nearby; soft evening light.

Phone-first composition: clear compact narrative grouping, essential faces, hands and objects comfortably inside all edges. Show the complete scene without border. No collage or multi-panel layout.
Owner-approved writing: render the following EXACT text, and no other writing, on the physical surface described in the scene. Use generous size, clear orthographic shapes and accurate Devanagari. The same text remains live app content. Do not substitute, omit, add or invent letters. No watermark, UI or extra labels.
बृहत्कथा
The writing is the book title sourced from the course, an interpretive title label, not an invented historical Paishachi quotation. Render only that title on the visible manuscript.

sources.title: Kathāsaritsāgara, taraṅgas 7 and 8 (Digital Corpus of Sanskrit files KSS, 1, 7 and KSS, 1, 8), the story retold in new, simple sentences with eight real half-verses and verses quoted
sources.note: The plot follows Somadeva's text: after hearing the great tale from Kāṇabhūti in the Vindhya forest, Guṇāḍhya writes it in the language of the ghosts, in his own blood, seven lakhs of verses in seven years; King Sātavāhana scorns it; Guṇāḍhya reads six of the seven tales leaf by leaf to the animals and burns them; the king, hearing of it from hunters, comes, asks for the tale, and takes the last lakh, the life of Naravāhanadatta. The quoted lines are Somadeva's own words; the rest is new Sanskrit in the present tense. The last sentence, about ghosts who come late, is this course's own story, not Somadeva's.

image.brief: A lean bearded poet in white sitting under a banyan tree in a wild forest, a palm leaf on his knee, writing with his own finger in a shallow bowl of dark red; a stack of finished leaves beside him; small blue-lit spirits listening between the trunks; a tall dignified blue spirit, Kāṇabhūti, nearby; soft evening light.

alt.en: A poet under a banyan writes on a palm leaf with a dark red liquid while blue spirits listen
alt.hi: बरगद के नीचे गहरे लाल द्रव से ताड़पत्र पर लिखता कवि, सुनती नीली भूत

meaning.en: Guṇāḍhya, the great poet, lives in the forest.
meaning.hi: महाकवि गुणाढ्य वन में रहता है।

meaning.en: He writes a story in the ghosts' language.
meaning.hi: वह भूतों की भाषा में कथा लिखता है।

meaning.en: There is no ink.
meaning.hi: स्याही नहीं है।

passage.sa: मैतां विद्याधरा हार्षुर् इति ताम् आत्मशोणितैः अटव्यां मष्यभावाच् च लिलेख स महाकविः

meaning.en: “So that the Vidyādharas should not carry it off, and for want of ink in the forest, that great poet wrote it with his own blood.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “विद्याधर इसे न ले जाएँ, इसलिए, और वन में स्याही के अभाव में, उस महाकवि ने उसे अपने रक्त से लिखा।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

passage.sa: पैशाच्या भाषया तया निबद्धा सप्तभिर् वर्षैर् ग्रन्थलक्षाणि सप्त सा

meaning.en: “In that language of the ghosts, composed in seven years: seven lakhs of verses.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “भूतों की उस भाषा में, सात वर्षों में रची गई: सात लाख श्लोक।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

meaning.en: There are seven tales.
meaning.hi: सात कथाएँ हैं।

image.brief: A pillared court hall in a stone city on a river; a proud young king in red and gold with a pearl necklace holding up a palm-leaf book at arm's length with a sneer; two young disciples in pale saffron standing back, the tall one stiff, the round-faced one near tears; sunlight through the pillars.

alt.en: A king holds a palm-leaf book at arm's length with a sneer as two young disciples stand back
alt.hi: पत्तों की पुस्तक को दूर से उपहास में थामे राजा, पीछे खड़े दो शिष्य

meaning.en: The two disciples carry the book.
meaning.hi: दोनों शिष्य पुस्तक ले जाते हैं।

meaning.en: The king looks at the book.
meaning.hi: राजा पुस्तक को देखता है।

passage.sa: प्रमाणं सप्तलक्षाणि पैशाचं नीरसं वचः शोणितेनाक्षरन्यासो धिक्पिशाचकथाम् इमाम्

meaning.en: “Its measure: seven lakhs, in the piśāca tongue, dull speech; the letters set down in blood: shame on this ghost-tale!” (the king, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “इसका माप सात लाख, पिशाच-भाषा में, नीरस वचन; अक्षर रक्त से लिखे: इस पिशाच-कथा को धिक्कार!” (राजा, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

meaning.en: The king mocks it.
meaning.hi: राजा निन्दा करता है।

meaning.en: Guṇāḍhya becomes downcast.
meaning.hi: गुणाढ्य उदास हो जाता है।

passage.sa: तत्त्वज्ञेन कृतावज्ञः को नामान्तर् न तप्यते

meaning.en: “Who, scorned by one who knows the truth, does not burn within?” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “तत्त्व जानने वाले से अपमानित होकर भला कौन भीतर नहीं जलता?” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

gloss.en: by one who knows the truth

image.brief: A small clearing on a rocky rise at dusk; a lean bearded poet in white feeding palm leaves one by one into a square stone fire-pit, holding up a leaf as if reading aloud; two young disciples in pale saffron standing close, wet-eyed; a quiet ring of deer, boars and birds sitting very still, listening; thin smoke curling upward.

alt.en: A poet burns palm leaves one by one in a fire-pit as deer and birds sit listening in a ring
alt.hi: अग्निकुण्ड में एक-एक ताड़पत्र जलाता कवि, घेरे में चुपचाप सुनते मृग और पक्षी

meaning.en: Guṇāḍhya makes a fire-pit.
meaning.hi: गुणाढ्य अग्निकुण्ड बनाता है।

meaning.en: He reads out the leaves one by one.
meaning.hi: वह एक-एक पत्र पढ़कर सुनाता है।

meaning.en: He throws the leaf into the fire.
meaning.hi: वह पत्र को आग में फेंकता है।

passage.sa: तत्राग्नौ पत्त्रम् एकैकं शिष्याभ्यां साश्रु वीक्षितः वाचयित्वा स चिक्षेप श्रावयन् मृगपक्षिणः

meaning.en: “There, watched tearfully by his two disciples, he read out the leaves one by one and threw each into the fire, letting the beasts and birds hear.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “वहाँ, दोनों शिष्यों की आँसुओं भरी दृष्टि के बीच, उसने एक-एक पत्र पढ़कर आग में फेंका, मृगों और पक्षियों को सुनाते हुए।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

meaning.en: The deer and the birds listen.
meaning.hi: मृग और पक्षी सुनते हैं।

meaning.en: “Leaving their food of grass, listening with tearful eyes.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “घास का भोजन छोड़कर, आँसू भरी आँखों से सुनते हुए।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

image.brief: The clearing at dawn: the fire burnt low, grey ash in the stone pit; the young king, humbled, kneeling before the lean bearded poet and holding out both hands; the poet offering a single small bundle of palm leaves; two disciples behind; a few small blue-lit ghosts at the clearing's edge, arriving too late, watching from between the trees.

alt.en: A humbled king kneels and receives a last bundle of palm leaves from a poet beside a burnt-out fire
alt.hi: बुझी आग के पास घुटनों पर राजा, कवि से ताड़पत्रों की अन्तिम गठरी लेता हुआ

meaning.en: The king bows to Guṇāḍhya.
meaning.hi: राजा गुणाढ्य को प्रणाम करता है।

meaning.en: The king wants the story.
meaning.hi: राजा कथा चाहता है।

passage.sa: राजन् षड्ग्रन्थलक्षाणि मया दग्धानि षट्कथाः लक्षम् एकम् इदं त्व् अस्ति कथैका सैव गृह्यताम्

meaning.en: “O king, six lakhs of verses, six tales, have been burnt by me; one lakh, this one tale, remains: let that one be taken.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: “हे राजन्, मैंने छह लाख श्लोक, छह कथाएँ, जला दिए हैं; यह एक लाख, एक कथा, बची है: वही ली जाए।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

meaning.en: The king takes the story.
meaning.hi: राजा कथा को ग्रहण करता है।

passage.sa: अथ तां गुणाढ्यदत्ताम् आदाय कथां बृहत्कथां नाम्ना नृपतिर् अगान् निजनगरं नरवाहनदत्तचरितमयीम्

meaning.en: Then the king, taking the story that Guṇāḍhya had given, named the Bṛhatkathā, made of the deeds of Naravāhanadatta, went to his own city. (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.8)
meaning.hi: तब राजा गुणाढ्य की दी हुई कथा को लेकर, जिसका नाम बृहत्कथा है, जो नरवाहनदत्त के चरित से बनी है, अपने नगर को गया। (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.8)

gloss.en: made of the deeds of Naravāhanadatta

meaning.en: Some ghosts come late.
meaning.hi: कुछ भूत देर से आते हैं।
